notes:
A general term for substances produced through chemical processes, including laboratory reagents, industrial chemicals, cleaning agents, and other synthetic compounds. Common in safety instructions, environmental news, and scientific contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {化学|かがく}{薬品|やくひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}り{扱|あつか}い→取り扱い：09806_toriatsukai⟧ — handling of chemicals
- {化学|かがく}{薬品|やくひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}→保管：11442_hokan⟧ — storage of chemicals
- ⟦{有害|ゆうがい}→有害：13002_yuugai⟧{化学|かがく}{薬品|やくひん} — hazardous chemicals
- {化学|かがく}{薬品|やくひん}⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧ — chemical products manufacturer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{薬品|やくひん}→薬品：11055_yakuhin⟧ — chemicals; medicine (broader, includes pharmaceuticals)
- {試薬|しやく} — reagent (specifically for laboratory use)
- ⟦{化学|かがく}{物質|ぶっしつ}→化学物質：19856_kagakubusshitsu⟧ — chemical substance (more general/scientific)
- ⟦{劇薬|げきやく}→劇薬：21657_gekiyaku⟧ — powerful/dangerous drug or chemical
